text:
Stuttgart’s median asking rents sit at 15.98 €/m², up 0.1 % YoY and 15.3 % over the past five years, keeping the city the third‑most expensive of the 37‑city sample. The market remains balanced, with a 29‑day average time on market and 23 % of listings let within a week.

Affordability is tight: a 60 m² unit costs about 959 € per month, while rent‑burden for two residents is 18.3 % and vacancy stands at 1.8 %. Asking rents command a 54 % premium over the 2022 census existing rent of 10.39 €/m².

The model estimate forecasts median asking rents of 16.7 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 16.35 €/m² and 17.22 €/m², implying a 4.5 % increase.
